verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an API that apps can reach with access tokens instead of an interactive login, and says it enables "workflow automation" and "external rendering". It also ships Docker Compose and Helm deployments and a self-hostable MCP server, which together allow automation without the UI. Missing for 10: an explicit headless mode or CLI, documented CI/pipeline usage or examples, a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use access tokens as an alternative login authentication. They can allow an app to access Penpot's API.
Get extensive access to objects and properties to enable external rendering, workflow automation, enhanced app functionality, and more.
Deploy the MCP server in your own environment without relying on third-party clouds.
